name: stri_timezone_get
title: Set or Get Default Time Zone in stringi

origin.description: Gets the current default time zone.
origin.details: Until stri_timezone_set is called, the default comes from the operating system through ICU. The result is the ID component of stri_timezone_info.
origin.value: A single string with the current default time zone identifier.

translation.description: ICU identifier of the current default time zone.
translation.details: The identifier is the ID from stri_timezone_info of the default zone. stri_timezone_set changes it for the process.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_timezone_get
x = stri_timezone_get()
print(f"stri_timezone_get() returns {x}.")
